race.comment: QUEDJINUP (11) resumes with the strongest exposed profile after winning on debut at Bunbury and then finishing second at this track in Open grade, beaten just under a length as a well-supported favourite. Showed enough in her Lark Hill trial to suggest she's up to the mark on resumption. NAILED'EM (5) has race fitness on his side after a sound Bunbury fourth when tightened on jumping and beaten just under two lengths, and his 1200m record gives him a clear platform to improve second-up. SECRET PLANET (9) is the lightly raced danger, having won his only race start at Northam on heavy ground as a well-supported favourite before a recent Lark Hill trial. Pike sticks and he can keep the ball rolling. UNIMANDO (3) brings winning form after scoring by a length and a half in a Mdn at Northam and was a narrow second at this venue prior, though he now has to carry that form into stronger company. BARRON BILL (1) is an exciting gelding on resumption who can't be discounted.
